note: GATE.md §2. These limits change only by a new written decision: an amendment in GATE.md §8, dated, with a reason, committed together with the change to this file. There is deliberately no command-line flag that raises any of them. Sizing: the plan is 5 boards, so 6 leaves one slot of headroom; 5 boards with at most 2 retries each is at most 15 requests in the worst case, and 12 is chosen below that on purpose so that a run where several boards flap is stopped by the budget rather than completing slowly.
